assumptions.claim: The call is not a nested re-entry into a nonReentrant function on the Raffle clone.
The raffle is in Status.Active on entry (and therefore is an initialized clone holding the escrowed prize, since the shared implementation sets status = Status.Refunding in constructor).
The current block timestamp is within the post-sale draw request window [endTime, uint256(endTime) + 2 days) and endTime >= 1.
At least one entry was sold before sale end (totalEntries > 0).
msg.value covers both the pre-quoted VRF fee (quotedFee) and the actual VRF fee (paidPrice) paid to i_vrfV2PlusWrapper.
block.timestamp fits within uint64 without high-bit truncation when cast via drawRequestedAt = uint64(block.timestamp) at Raffle.sol:L253.
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found (Raffle.sol:L244-L247 bounds block.timestamp < uint256(endTime) + 2 days where endTime is uint64, which can exceed type(uint64).max by up to 2 days if endTime > type(uint64).max - 2 days; relies on EVM chain clock remaining <= type(uint64).max)

assumptions.claim: i_vrfV2PlusWrapper implements calculateRequestPriceNative and requestRandomWordsInNative without reverting for callbackGasLimit = 300_000, requestConfirmations = 30, and numWords = 1, accepts requestPrice wei matching calculateRequestPriceNative, and returns the requestId it will later pass to rawFulfillRandomWords.
assumptions.establishedBy: nothing found (RaffleFactory.sol:L67,L183-L185 and Raffle.sol:L157,L610-L613 and VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L45 check non-zero address, non-empty code, and link() at deployment; runtime wrapper behavior is external)

assumptions.claim: When excess = msg.value - paidPrice > 0, msg.sender accepts native ETH via an empty-calldata call without reverting or exhausting gas.

callers: External permissionless caller during [endTime, drawRequestDeadline()) while Status.Active and totalEntries > 0 (Raffle.sol:L240)

calls.propagates: Reverts with ReentrancyGuardReentrantCall if REENTRANCY_GUARD_STORAGE == ENTERED (2), sets the slot to ENTERED (2) before the body, and resets it to NOT_ENTERED (1) after exit (ReentrancyGuard.sol:L69-L73,L88-L106); does not block rawFulfillRandomWords, onERC721Received, or ERC721 transfers.
Reverts with InvalidStatus(status) unless status == Status.Active (Raffle.sol:L571-L573).
Returns uint256(endTime) + RaffleConstants.DRAW_REQUEST_TIMEOUT (endTime + 2 days) without uint256 overflow because endTime is uint64 (Raffle.sol:L458-L460, RaffleConstants.sol:L33).
Calls i_vrfV2PlusWrapper.calculateRequestPriceNative(callbackGasLimit, 1) via STATICCALL with callbackGasLimit = 300_000 and returns quotedFee (Raffle.sol:L436-L438,L47).
ABI-encodes ExtraArgsV1({ nativePayment: true }) with the 4-byte selector EXTRA_ARGS_V1_TAG (VRFV2PlusClient.sol:L7,L22-L26).

Queries requestPrice = i_vrfV2PlusWrapper.calculateRequestPriceNative(_callbackGasLimit, _numWords) and calls i_vrfV2PlusWrapper.requestRandomWordsInNative{value: requestPrice}(_callbackGasLimit, _requestConfirmations, _numWords, extraArgs), returning (requestId, requestPrice) without checking requestPrice <= msg.value (VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L76-L89).

External calls to immutable i_vrfV2PlusWrapper (Raffle.sol:L437, VRFV2PlusWrapperConsumerBase.sol:L82,L84-L86); caller relies on wrapper returning a valid fee and requestId, while guarding against any synchronous callback to rawFulfillRandomWords via _requestInFlight = true (Raffle.sol:L254,L511) and re-checking paidPrice <= msg.value (Raffle.sol:L258).

Transfers excess = msg.value - paidPrice wei to msg.sender with empty calldata, zero return-data copy, and gas() when excess != 0 after state updates are complete and while nonReentrant is active, reverting with NativeRefundFailed(msg.sender, excess) if success == false (Raffle.sol:L262-L270).

Returns uint256(drawRequestedAt) + RaffleConstants.DRAW_CALLBACK_TIMEOUT (drawRequestedAt + 2 days) when drawRequestedAt != 0, and 0 when drawRequestedAt == 0 (Raffle.sol:L463-L465, RaffleConstants.sol:L36).

invariants.claim: requestDraw can succeed only when status == Status.Active, totalEntries >= 1, and endTime <= block.timestamp < uint256(endTime) + 2 days.
Any synchronous callback to rawFulfillRandomWords during requestRandomnessPayInNative observes _requestInFlight == true and is ignored without resolving the raffle before vrfRequestId is written.

Both quotedFee and actual paidPrice are bounded by msg.value (quotedFee <= msg.value and paidPrice <= msg.value), preventing underflow in excess = msg.value - paidPrice and preventing pre-existing contract ETH from subsidizing a draw request.

On successful completion, status is transitioned out of Status.Active to Status.Drawing, drawRequestedAt == uint64(block.timestamp), vrfRequestId == requestId, _requestInFlight == false, and 100% of msg.value is distributed between i_vrfV2PlusWrapper (paidPrice) and msg.sender (excess).

openQuestions: unclear; need to inspect the deployed target-chain i_vrfV2PlusWrapper contract and VRF coordinator configuration to verify that VRF_CALLBACK_GAS_LIMIT = 300_000 (RaffleConstants.sol:L39) and VRF_REQUEST_CONFIRMATIONS = 30 (RaffleConstants.sol:L42) are within the wrapper's permitted gas and confirmation bounds.
